tagline: World's largest wholesale distributor of swimming pool supplies and equipment
hero_kpi_rationale: The pool and landscape sector is characterized by strong recurring demand for maintenance products and services. Approximately 64% of sales come from maintenance and repair of existing installations, generating predictable and non-discretionary revenue streams independent of economic cycles.

kpis.name: Recurring Sales Share
kpis.description: The share of recurring sales reflects sustained, non-discretionary demand for maintenance products and services for existing pools, generating stable revenues regardless of economic conditions.

kpis.name: Sales Growth
kpis.description: Negative sales growth reflects declining demand for new pool construction and renovations due to slowing consumer discretionary spending and high financing costs

kpis.name: Renovation Sales Share
kpis.description: The share of renovation sales reflects demand for repairs, modernizations, and upgrades of existing pools, sensitive to economic conditions and real estate values.

kpis.name: Number of Sales Centers
kpis.explanation: Total number of sales centers operated by the company
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, the company operated 456 strategically located sales centers in North America, Europe, and Australia.

kpis.name: Product Cost Inflation
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year percentage change in product input costs
kpis.description: Product cost inflation moderated to approximately 2 to 3% in 2025, including a 1% impact from U.S. tariffs, compared to 1 to 2% expected in 2026.

kpis.name: In-ground Swimming Pools Installed Base
kpis.explanation: Estimated number of in-ground swimming pools in the United States
kpis.description: The semi-inground pool market in the U.S. is estimated at 5.5 million units, representing a substantial customer base for maintenance, repair, and renovation services.
kpis.signal: Indicator of addressable market size and growth potential

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K)

stories_kpis.name: Recurring Sales Share in 2025
stories_kpis.explanation: Percentage of sales from maintenance and minor repair of existing pool installations in 2025
stories_kpis.description: In 2025, approximately 64% of sales came from maintenance and minor repair of existing pool installations, reflecting ongoing non-discretionary demand.
stories_kpis.signal: Indicator of financial health and revenue stability

stories_kpis.name: Sales Growth in 2025
stories_kpis.explanation: Year-over-year change in total sales in 2025
stories_kpis.description: Sales in 2025 decreased by 3 to 5% compared to 2024, primarily due to the decline in new pool construction (down from 62,000 to 60,000 units) driven by cautious consumer discretionary spending and high financing costs.
stories_kpis.signal: Indicator of market demand and economic conditions

stories_kpis.name: New Pool Construction Units 2025
stories_kpis.explanation: Estimated number of new in-ground swimming pool units constructed in 2025
stories_kpis.description: Units of in-ground residential pool construction declined from 62,000 in 2024 to approximately 60,000 in 2025, reflecting consumer caution amid high financing rates.
stories_kpis.signal: Indicator of discretionary consumer spending capacity

ai_positioning.summary: Pool Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual 10-K report. The company focuses on its role as a distributor of swimming pool and landscape products, with no reference to AI technologies.

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Increased competition could negatively impact the company's sales and gross margins.
risks.score_rationale: The market is fragmented with numerous competing distributors. The company faces increasing competition for market share among pool and landscape product distributors.

risks.title: Economic Sensitivity
risks.summary: Economic fluctuations and high interest rates may reduce demand for new pool construction and major renovations.
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly exposed to macroeconomic fluctuations, particularly changes in mortgage interest rates, consumer confidence, and existing home sales, which directly affect demand for pools and landscape products.

risks.title: Inflation and Rising Costs
risks.summary: Rising costs may compress margins, although the company generally has the ability to pass through price increases along its supply chain.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to product cost inflation and trade tariffs. In 2025, cost inflation reached 2 to 3%, including 1% related to U.S. tariffs.

risks.title: Supplier Dependence
risks.summary: Supplier dependence could impact sales and customer satisfaction in the event of supply disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on a large number of manufacturers to source distributed products. Supply chain disruptions or quality issues could impact its ability to serve customers.

risks.title: Technology and Cybersecurity Risks
risks.summary: Technology-related risks could impact operations if adequate cybersecurity measures are not maintained.
risks.score_rationale: The company uses technology to manage operations, mobile applications (Regal and E-Z Clor), and customer relationships. Risks include technical failures and data security.

governance.voting_structure_note: Single class of common stock, 1 vote per share.
